rules.name: Slot start parsing
rules.action: Parse appointment_slot_start as ISO 8601 string into datetime
rules.rationale: Input must be parsable; malformed dates are data defects and must be caught early.
rules.audit_hook: Validation step: parse_datetime() returns error on invalid input; test with edge cases including '2024-03-15T09:00:00Z' and 'invalid'

rules.name: Slot end parsing
rules.action: Parse appointment_slot_end as ISO 8601 string into datetime
rules.rationale: End time must be valid; malformed inputs indicate data quality issues.
rules.audit_hook: Validation step: parse_datetime() returns error on invalid input; test with edge cases including '2024-03-15T17:00:00Z' and 'invalid'

rules.name: Status normalization
rules.action: Map slot_status to standardized enum values
rules.rationale: Ensures consistency across clinics; avoids semantic drift in status reporting.
rules.audit_hook: Test with all valid and invalid values; verify output matches expected enum set
rules.failure_loudness: Map to default if absent or invalid

rules.name: Channel type normalization
rules.action: Map channel_type to standardized enum values
rules.rationale: Standardizes communication channels for audit and compliance purposes.
rules.audit_hook: Test with all valid and invalid values; verify output matches expected enum set
rules.failure_loudness: Map to default if absent or invalid

rules.name: Skip reason code validation
rules.action: If skip_reason_code is present, retain as-is; otherwise map to 'unknown'
rules.rationale: Preserves diagnostic context while ensuring all records have a reason field.
rules.audit_hook: Test with empty and non-empty values; verify output shape matches target schema
rules.failure_loudness: No failure; absence is handled by default mapping

rules.name: Conflict flag derivation
rules.action: Set calendar_conflict_flag to true if conflict exists and slot_status != 'scheduled'
rules.rationale: Identifies when a scheduled slot is overridden by another, which must be reported.
rules.audit_hook: Test with known conflict and non-conflict inputs; verify flag accuracy

rules.name: Double-booking detection
rules.action: If clinic_id is 'CLINIC_07' and double_booked_flag == true, set rule_applied to 'double_booking_defect'
rules.rationale: Known defect in one clinic's export; must be flagged explicitly for audit.
rules.audit_hook: Test with CLINIC_07 records and non-CLINIC_07 records; verify flag is set only when condition matches
rules.failure_loudness: No failure; rule applies only if condition met

rules.name: Merge evidence derivation
rules.action: If merged_with_slot_id is present and status == 'merged', set evidence_merge_target to value of merged_with_slot_id
rules.rationale: Provides traceability for slot merges; required for reconciliation reporting.
rules.audit_hook: Test with merge and non-merge inputs; verify target field is populated only when condition met
rules.failure_loudness: No failure; absent value maps to null

invariants.name: No diagnosis in message content
invariants.description: All message templates used must be approved by the plain-language review board and contain no diagnostic information.
invariants.how_checked: At pipeline ingestion, a schema validation rule checks that template_id references only approved templates; any reference to diagnosis is flagged as invalid.
invariants.audit_hook: Review board approval list is validated against template_id in input; test with known diagnosis-containing and diagnosis-free templates

invariants.name: No identifiers in logs
invariants.description: All output records must not contain patient identifiers or any personally identifiable information (PII).
invariants.how_checked: Schema validation at pipeline ingestion ensures no fields such as patient_id, name, or dob are present; any field with PII is rejected.
invariants.audit_hook: Static schema scan for PII fields; test with sample records containing PII to verify rejection

invariants.name: Exception entries must name their rule and calendar evidence
invariants.description: Every exception entry must include a rule_applied field and at least one piece of evidence (e.g., slot_start, merge_target, skip_source).
invariants.how_checked: Validation step: every output record must have rule_applied populated; if absent, halt with diagnostic.
invariants.audit_hook: Test with records missing rule_applied or evidence fields; verify pipeline halts and logs error

invariants.name: Total reconciled slots equals sum of scheduled + skipped + merged
invariants.description: The total number of processed slots must match the sum of scheduled, skipped, and merged entries.
invariants.how_checked: At output stage, a reconciliation check compares input count with output count; mismatch triggers hard error.
invariants.audit_hook: Run reconciliation test on sample data: 4100 appointments across 14 clinics; verify counts match

invariants.name: No double-booking in output except for known defect
invariants.description: All slots must be uniquely scheduled, with no overlapping time ranges unless explicitly flagged as a known defect.
invariants.how_checked: At output stage, validate that slot_start and slot_end do not overlap across records; exceptions only allowed when clinic_id == 'CLINIC_07' and double_booked_flag == true.
invariants.audit_hook: Run overlap detection on all slots in test dataset; verify no overlaps outside known defect

ordering.rule: Input records are processed in the order of appointment_slot_start ascending, then by clinic_id ascending
ordering.rationale: Ensures deterministic output and consistent exception reporting across runs; prevents ordering-dependent anomalies.

rounding.rule: No rounding occurs; all numeric fields are exact as parsed from input
rounding.rationale: All time values are ISO 8601 strings; no floating-point arithmetic or approximations used.
rounding.unit_discipline: All timestamps are in ISO 8601 format; unitless numbers are not present

serialization.rule: Output is serialized as JSON with double-quoted strings, no trailing commas, and all dates in ISO 8601 format
serialization.rationale: Ensures compatibility with downstream systems that parse JSON strictly.

idempotency.rule: Repeated application of the transformation produces identical output for same input
idempotency.how_achieved: All transformations are deterministic; no stateful components or randomization used.
idempotency.rationale: No caching, no side effects; every field is derived from input with fixed rules.

failure_handling.rule: If input cannot be classified (e.g., malformed date), the process halts immediately and returns diagnostic
failure_handling.diagnostic_format: Error: Input does not match any known variant; fields present: [list]; expected: [list]
failure_handling.rationale: Silent drops or guessed mappings are prohibited; all ambiguity must be surfaced.

evidence_recency.statement: All facts in the supplied material (e.g., 2.3% conflict rate, one clinic's double-booking defect) are treated as current as of this engagement
evidence_recency.dependency_marking: The 2.3% conflict rate is used to validate expected number of conflicts; the CLINIC_07 defect is hardcoded into rule R07
